noPermission: You need the integration.manage permission to connect an HR system.
title: HR system (HRMS)
hint: Keep employees and organisational units up to date from your HR system — Mawred Plus or any other. The HR system (or its middleware) sends batches of records to FlowZa Time with an API key; each batch is checked like an import file and applied in the background.
enabled: Receive batches from the HR system
enabledHint: When off, every batch is refused (the API keys stay valid).
endpointHint: POST {{endpoint}}/employees and {{endpoint}}/org-units with Authorization: Bearer <API key>. See the HRMS guide for the format.
presetHint: A starting point. Mawred Plus does not publish its field names: check the names your extract uses and edit the mapping below.
presetLoaded: The preset's mapping was filled in. Review it, then save.
defaultBranchHint: Branch of a NEW employee whose record names none. Leave empty to refuse such records.
mappingHint: HR system field → FlowZa field. Leave the list empty to use the preset's mapping. Fields that are not mapped are ignored (the batch lists them).
valueMappingsHint: Status, gender and contract-type labels of the HR system (Arabic or English) translated to FlowZa values. Leave a list empty to use the preset's.
usingPreset: Empty: the preset's mapping ({{count}} entries) is used.

keys.title: API keys
keys.hint: Machine keys for the HR system. A key belongs to this organisation only; its secret is shown once, when it is created — only a fingerprint is stored. Keys expire; create a new one and revoke the old one before the date.
keys.name: Name
keys.revokeHint: The HR system can no longer send batches with this key. This cannot be undone.
keys.createdHint: This is the only time the key is shown. Store it in the HR system's secret store; FlowZa Time keeps only a fingerprint.

batches.title: Recent batches
batches.hint: The last batches the HR system sent, with what happened to their records.
